    Align observed and simulated series

    align_forecast_series.Rd

    Align observed and simulated series

    align_forecast_series(
  observed,
  simulated,
  observed_time_column = "date_time",
  observed_value_column = "value",
  simulated_time_column = "date_time",
  simulated_value_column = "value",
  join = c("inner", "full"),
  duplicate_action = c("error", "mean", "first"),
  interval_minutes = NULL,
  timezone = "UTC",
  metadata = list()
)

    Arguments

    observed, simulated

    Input tables.

    observed_time_column, simulated_time_column

    Time columns.

    observed_value_column, simulated_value_column

    Value columns.

    join

    Join type.

    duplicate_action

    Duplicate handling.

    interval_minutes

    Expected interval.

    timezone

    Timezone.

    metadata

    Metadata.

    Value

    An aligned-series result.
